brands.name: Meyerhoffer Surf
brands.short_description: Independent California surfboards by designer Thomas Meyerhoffer, based on the coast in Montara between San Francisco and Santa Cruz.

models.name: XYZ
models.description: The third generation of the Meyerhoffer longboard, the XYZ is a high-performance surfboard that brings together the best of longboards and shortboards. Smooth noseriding as well as hard turns off the tail come easy on the XYZ.

models.name: Slip In
models.description: The Slip In takes the classic single-fin design into the future with a radical tail design that deliver a dynamic performance. The innovative concave outline of the tail allows you to draw classic lines, stall in the barrel, or turn like a tri-fin – all with the superior speed of a single-fin.

models.name: Super Normal
models.description: Welcome to the Supernormal: your everyday shortboard. A favorite board for several of our ambassadors – it’s fun, it’s functional and about as traditional as Meyerhoffer’s designs get. Based on the popular Horsepill, the Supernormal is the result of careful tweaking with the target to create a board that performs better in more types of waves.

models.name: Tippin Point
models.description: When we were developing the third-generation Meyerhoffer longboard, the XYZ, we started to question how far the concept of creating a longboard with two distinct zones and a narrow waist could go. So we decided to develop a shape where we pushed every design aspect to the Tippin Point.

models.name: White Ass
models.description: Retro future glide. The White Ass is a modern intepretation of a simmons hull where a slighly more performance oriented tail with a double concave spiral vee is carefully blended with the hull in the nose to get you a ride with more drive than on a traditional Simmons hull.
